"""Backend API integration tests — core CRUD and join/leave.

Executed via ``pytest .`` from the workspace root.  The ``client`` fixture
is provided by the scaffold-owned ``conftest.py``; every test receives it as
an argument.  In-memory store state is reset before each test via
``backend.store.reset()``.
"""

import pytest

from backend.store import reset


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _clean_store():
    """Reset in-memory store before every test for order-independence."""
    reset()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _make_run(client, **overrides) -> dict:
    """POST a valid run and return the parsed JSON body (asserts 201)."""
    payload = {
        "title": "Friday 5K",
        "datetime": "2026-09-05T17:30",
        "meeting_location": "Riverside Park",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    resp = client.post("/runs", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    return resp.json()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_create_run(client):
    """POST /runs with valid fields → 201 + full Run object with generated id."""
    body = _make_run(client)

    # Generated identity
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], str) and len(body["id"]) > 0

    # Required fields echoed back
    assert body["title"] == "Friday 5K"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2026-09-05T17:30"
    assert body["meeting_location"] == "Riverside Park"

    # Defaults / server-set fields
    assert body["participants"] == []
    assert "created_at" in body


def test_create_run_missing_required(client):
    """POST /runs with blank title → 422 validation_error envelope."""
    resp = client.post(
        "/runs",
        json={
            "title": "",
            "datetime": "2026-09-05T17:30",
            "meeting_location": "Riverside Park",
        },
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    err = resp.json()
    assert "error" in err
    assert err["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"
    assert "message" in err["error"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. List
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_list_runs(client):
    """GET /runs after creating one → list contains it with correct fields."""
    created = _make_run(client)

    resp = client.get("/runs")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    runs = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(runs, list)
    assert len(runs) == 1

    item = runs[0]
    assert item["id"] == created["id"]
    assert item["title"] == "Friday 5K"
    assert item["datetime"] == "2026-09-05T17:30"
    assert item["meeting_location"] == "Riverside Park"
    assert item["participants"] == []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Detail (known + unknown)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_get_run_detail(client):
    """GET /runs/{id} → full detail; unknown id → 404 run_not_found."""
    created = _make_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    # --- known run ---
    resp = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == run_id
    assert body["title"] == "Friday 5K"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2026-09-05T17:30"
    assert body["meeting_location"] == "Riverside Park"
    assert body["participants"] == []
    assert "created_at" in body

    # --- unknown run ---
    resp = client.get("/runs/does-not-exist-99999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    err = resp.json()
    assert "error" in err
    assert err["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"
    assert "message" in err["error"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Join
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_join_run(client):
    """POST /runs/{id}/join → participant appears in updated run."""
    run_id = _make_run(client)["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert "Alice" in body["participants"]
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 1


def test_join_run_duplicate(client):
    """Second join with same name (case-insensitive) → 409 duplicate_participant."""
    run_id = _make_run(client)["id"]

    # First join succeeds
    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Alice"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200

    # Second join (different case) is rejected
    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "alice"})
    assert resp.status_code == 409
    err = resp.json()
    assert "error" in err
    assert err["error"]["code"] == "duplicate_participant"
    assert "message" in err["error"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Leave
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_leave_run(client):
    """Join then leave → participant is removed, count back to zero."""
    run_id = _make_run(client)["id"]

    # Join first
    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/join", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert "Bob" in resp.json()["participants"]

    # Leave
    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert "Bob" not in body["participants"]
    assert len(body["participants"]) == 0


def test_leave_run_not_found(client):
    """Leave with a name not on the run → 404 participant_not_found."""
    run_id = _make_run(client)["id"]

    resp = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/leave", json={"name": "Charlie"})
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    err = resp.json()
    assert "error" in err
    assert err["error"]["code"] == "participant_not_found"
    assert "message" in err["error"]
